newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Computer Sciences started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Computer Sciences started.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said analyst Mark Wolfenberger started coverage of Computer Sciences Corp with a hold rating.
-- Estimates Computer Sciences' fiscal 1997 earnings at $2.90 per share, 1998 earnings at $3.40 and 1999 at $3.90.

-- Said believes company is in transition from predominantly systems integration background for federal government to a lend of systems intergration, outsourcing and value added services to the higher margin commercial sector.
